description: The line plot, titled "Whisper fine-tuning, type = tiny," illustrates the evolution of Word Error Rate (WER) across six epochs for different fine-tuning configurations of the Whisper model with the "tiny" variant. The x-axis, labeled "epoch," is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 6, with integer tick marks at each epoch. The y-axis, labeled "WER," represents the word error rate and is a linear scale ranging from 30 to 70, with major gridlines and tick marks at intervals of 10. The plot contains six distinct lines, each corresponding to a different configuration as detailed in the legend. The "tiny AdaLoRA_int4" line, represented by a solid grey line with circle markers, starts at a WER of approximately 69 and shows a steady decline to a final value of about 40. The "tiny AdaLoRA_int8" line, shown as a solid grey line with square markers, begins at a WER of 60 and decreases to around 37. The "tiny int4" line, a dashed grey line with circle markers, starts at 69 and ends at approximately 40. The "tiny int8" line, a dashed grey line with square markers, starts at 60 and ends at about 36. The "tiny full" line, a dotted grey line with triangle markers, begins at a WER of 29 and remains relatively stable, ending at approximately 23. The data shows that all configurations exhibit a general downward trend in WER over the epochs, with the "tiny full" configuration consistently having the lowest WER, followed by the "tiny int8" and "tiny AdaLoRA_int8" configurations.
